bug.title: On a full page load of a public page, a signed-in member's bell shows no unread count: the count is fetched once before the session is restored, gets a 401 and is never retried
bug.symptoms: On a full load of /papers, /c/…, /search, /p/…, /discussion/… or /u/… the bell has no badge although the member has unread notifications; GET /v1/me/notifications returns 401 right after /v1/auth/refresh returns 200, and is not retried; /me (its card reports the count), /me/* and client-side navigation show the badge Since d36625b useSignedIn (components/nav/session.ts) is true from the localStorage signed-in hint before the access token is in memory; the fetch effect in global-nav.tsx keyed on effectiveSignedIn runs once, without a token, and its failure is swallowed
bug.expected: The unread count is fetched only once an access token is actually held (tokenStore.isAuthenticated), and again whenever the token store changes from no token to a token, so a full load of any public page shows the badge as soon as the session is restored; the signed-in hint still decides which nav actions show. A 401 never leaves a stale or missing badge once the session is restored. Tests: hint set and no token → no fetch; token arrives → fetch and badge; a first 401 followed by a restored token → badge
bug.actual: Members can't see they have notifications on most pages they open directly

bug.title: Sign-out still lands on the homepage smooth-scrolled down to "Why Scholium" instead of at the top
bug.symptoms: After Sign out from /me, /me/security or /papers (scrollY 0) the homepage opens and smooth-scrolls to y≈1586 over about 700 ms; useSignOut calls window.scrollTo(0, 0) immediately after router.replace("/") (session.ts ~L92-95), before the homepage renders, and the homepage sets scroll-behavior: smooth and scroll-padding-top on html
bug.expected: After sign-out the homepage is shown at scrollY 0 with no visible scroll movement, from any page and any starting offset (for example a full navigation to /, or a scroll to the top once the homepage has rendered that bypasses smooth scrolling). Tests (new session.test.ts): sign-out navigates to / and the scroll to the top happens after the navigation with behavior "instant"/"auto", not before it

bug.title: At 320-390 px the hero card's "Verified · signed by both authors · history intact" pill doesn't wrap and runs past the card and the screen
bug.symptoms: At 375 px the pill's right edge is at 387 px (cut by the screen edge); at 320 px the page is 336 px wide (16 px horizontal scroll) and the text is cut at "histor"
bug.expected: At 320-414 px the verified pill wraps (or shortens) inside the card with no clipped text and no horizontal page scroll; a CSS test asserts the pill can wrap (no nowrap at narrow widths, max-width 100%)
bug.actual: Overflowing pill and horizontal scroll on small phones

bug.title: `scholium verify` counts a listed paper as "awaiting moderation" when only its newer version is in the queue
bug.symptoms: With sch:pzhn-vanl-24rr v1 listed (public on /papers, counted listed on /network) and its v2 queued, the export summary reads "4 papers (2 listed, 2 awaiting moderation)"; _newest_version_listed in scholium_cli/verify.py looks only at the newest version and its docstring says the node serves no page until the newest version is listed, which is not what the node does
bug.expected: Per D1, a paper with any listed version and no hold in force is "listed" in the summary (optionally noting "1 newer version awaiting moderation"); a paper with no listed version stays "awaiting moderation"; held, corrected and retracted are unchanged. Tests: listed v1 + queued v2 counts as listed; only a queued v1 counts as awaiting moderation
bug.actual: The summary disagrees with the node
